topic: Lidar data requirements for speed estimation
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on improving the accuracy of speed estimations using Lidar data. It was requested that if a participant (Tolia) could provide the maximum object height within a session, it would significantly improve the ability to estimate speed more accurately. Additionally, relative measurements are needed, such as counting how many beams hit an object in different locations.
action_items: Someone needs to send data including maximum object height per session.
Relative beam count data must be provided for better analysis.
